title: Guess The Next Letter
summary: Shannon measured English by asking people to guess the next letter. Play his experiment against a passage you have not read, and watch what happens when a model is scored on text it has already memorised.

sources.title: Shannon, Prediction and Entropy of Printed English, Bell System Technical Journal 30 (1951)
Cover and King, A convergent gambling estimate of the entropy of English, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 24 (1978)
Cover and Thomas, Elements of Information Theory, chapter 2 and chapter 6
